name: Shimamura Hiroko
source:
[The outspoken, loud-mouthed vice-captain] 

She is childhood friends with Izuki and Shiori. She is the vice-captain of the basketball club and Izuki's assistant. 

She is blunt and doesn't hesitate to say things that Izuki would stammer over, which annoys some of the club members.

However, it seems that she is also causing stress for the kidnappers...

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara02.html]official site[/url]]
